facts.excerpt: loscream Halloscream transforms Luna Park Sydney into Sydney’s biggest Halloween festival from 29–31 October. Step into Escape the Circus, The Forgotten Children scare maze, and the Alienation immersive game, plus unlimited rides on operating attractions after dark. Upgrade to VIP for Patient Zero lounge access, Pulse Zombie Rave, a complimentary cocktail or mocktail, a limited-edition collectable pin, and a private fortune reading with harbour views.
